meta.name: V4 Launch Campaign
meta.objective: Execute the locked V4 wave-1 study end to end: import Gilardi and Zheng into Convex, register paper-audit packages, create the headline experiments, run canaries, monitor stability, and continue iterating until the V4 launch cohort is scientifically and operationally ready.

knownTools: Railway MCP plus linked sincere-freedom project
Media Cloud API key in local .env.local
knownConstraints: V4 matrix is already locked in docs/pilots/v4_specs.md and should not be reopened inside this workspace.
OpenAI is primary, with Anthropic and OpenRouter/Qwen as wave-1 controls.
Infrastructure is already hardened; this workspace starts from live-ready infra rather than greenfield runtime work.
bun dev should remain agent-owned during active launch loops so Convex and lab logs stay in agent context.
After runtime-affecting changes to apps/engine-temporal, shared runtime packages, Dockerfile, or railway.toml, Railway worker redeploy plus live verification is mandatory before resuming live runs.
unknowns: How many canary/stability loops the first target import will require before the full headline cohort is safe to launch.
Whether Zheng pairwise packaging will need any narrow runtime refinements once real live runs begin.
What launch-time OpenRouter Qwen model id should be frozen at experiment instantiation.
notes: Matrix spec workspace is terminally complete and the headline bundle is Gilardi plus Zheng.
Implementation-readiness workspace is terminally complete and left only live control-plane actions plus monitoring loops.
Infra-hardening workspace is terminally complete and proved Temporal-owned Media Cloud acquisition with a live smoke pass.
Local Gilardi and Zheng source bundles, import builders, and dry-run canaries already exist under scripts/v4.

objectiveModel.terminalObjective: Execute the locked V4 wave-1 study end to end: import Gilardi and Zheng into Convex, register paper-audit packages, create the headline experiments, run canaries, monitor stability, and continue iterating until the V4 launch cohort is scientifically and operationally ready.
successCriteria: Gilardi and Zheng source bundles are imported into Convex as evidence universes and evidence sets with the intended pinned source views.
Paper-audit packages for Gilardi and Zheng are registered live and inspectable.
Target canaries run successfully through the live control plane with a documented monitoring/debug ladder.
The headline experiment rows for the locked V4 matrix are created with provider, compatibility, and evidence-view settings matching docs/pilots/v4_specs.md.
Launch readiness is backed by explicit promotion gates, telemetry, and blocker accounting rather than ad hoc judgment.
nonGoals: Do not reopen V4 matrix design or provider-family research inside this workspace.
Do not re-enter infrastructure hardening except for narrow fixes exposed by live canaries.
Do not add Gemini, Grok, or appendix/watchlist providers to the headline launch loop.
Do not build a full generic pairwise engine unless a real Zheng blocker proves it necessary.
dependencyPolicy: Treat docs/pilots/v4_specs.md as the live scientific contract for the headline wave.
Use the existing local source bundles and import builders as the baseline path before adding any new acquisition work.
Prefer live control-plane progress over more preparatory refactors unless a concrete blocker appears.

capabilityTiers.label: Canary ready
capabilityTiers.definition: Target packages, imports, and the first live canaries exist and are monitorable.

capabilityTiers.label: Headline matrix instantiated
capabilityTiers.definition: All live evidence/package/experiment rows for the 20 headline experiments are created.

capabilityTiers.label: Launch stable
capabilityTiers.definition: Canary and early cohort runs have cleared the monitoring/debug ladder and the headline study is operationally safe to continue.

baselinePlan: Start with the fastest trustworthy live baseline: import Gilardi and Zheng, register packages, and run narrow canaries before instantiating the full matrix.
Use progressive validation: dry-run bundle path is already done, so the next ladder is live import -> live package inspection -> target canary -> condition canary -> cohort launch.
Keep the first bounded workflow centered on live control-plane creation and monitoring contracts, not on speculative code changes.
Only widen into broader launch loops after the first live target canaries clear promotion gates.
progressionLadder: environment discovery -> confirm live-ready baseline and remaining control-plane steps
target live setup -> import Gilardi and Zheng, register packages, create canaries
canary loop -> run, monitor, debug, and patch until target canaries are green
matrix instantiation -> create the 20 headline experiments
launch stability loop -> monitor early runs, heal blockers, and promote to full execution only when stable

searchRegimes.focus: Use the existing locked spec and implementation substrate to progress the live study as directly as possible.
Only explore narrow fixes or run-ops improvements when real canaries expose a blocker.

pruneRules: Prune speculative runtime refactors that are not demanded by a live canary or cohort blocker.
Prune appendix/watchlist execution until the headline Gilardi plus Zheng cohort is stable.
Prune any branch that reopens matrix design instead of advancing live launch readiness.
escalationRules: Escalate from workspace planning into deep-workflow only when the next step is a bounded live-execution or debugging slice with concrete validators.
Escalate into deeper runtime changes only after a real canary reproduces a blocker with logs and a bounded write scope.
promotionRules: Promote a target to matrix-ready only when its live canary passes and the monitoring/debug ladder is documented.
Promote the full headline cohort only when both Gilardi and Zheng baseline canaries are stable and blocker count is at or near zero.
Promote a runtime patch only if it improves canary pass rate or reduces launch blockers without reopening closed V4 design questions.

reviewRequired: Adding new headline providers or targets beyond the locked V4 spec
Changing the compatibility or evidence-view contract away from docs/pilots/v4_specs.md
Broad infrastructure redesign not forced by live launch blockers
stopConditions: Terminal objective met: live imports, packages, canaries, and the launch monitoring contract are all in place and stable enough to run the headline cohort.
Hard blocker: an external surface such as Convex, Railway, provider APIs, or source datasets becomes unavailable and prevents live execution.

budget.primaryCostControl: Use the narrowest live canaries that can falsify launch optimism before expanding to the full matrix.
budget.executionScope: One bounded launch workflow at a time, then direct implementation/monitoring until the next strategic blocker.
